correctness.rationale: The proof identifies fixed diagrams with equivariant partial matchings, classifies their entire cycle-orbit decomposition (singletons, unique antipodal pairing on even cycles, or L equivariant pairings of two length-L cycles), and uses a labeled matching EGF to count every rank. The highest coefficient counts all-equivariant transversal matchings. Losing exactly one length-L transversal pair yields coefficient ratio m_L(1+1_{2|L})^2/L, and formal division by lower-length factors recovers all multiplicities by induction. Independent enumeration using direct diagram multiplication checks every diagram-unit pair through degree four and invariance through degree five; degree-six coefficient identities and inversion were also checked. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.
